svg.aria-label: Where encryption applies in a typical system. In transit: TLS from the user to the load balancer, and mutual TLS between internal services so each side proves its identity. At rest: encrypted disks and database storage, plus application-level encryption of especially sensitive fields such as card numbers, so even a database administrator sees ciphertext. Secrets such as database passwords and API keys come from a secrets manager at runtime, not from code or config files, and are rotated automatically.
